evals.name: new-readme
evals.prompt: we've got a new dev starting monday and this repo has no README. can you write one so they can get set up on their own?
evals.expected_output: A new README.md with a quick start that installs, copies .env.example, starts Postgres with docker compose and runs npm run db:migrate before npm run dev; Node 22 as a prerequisite; every variable from .env.example documented without the secret from .env; only scripts that exist in package.json; concise. Not committed.
assertions: Every npm command in the README exists in package.json
README.md created with a quick start section
Database started and migrated before the app runs

evals.name: stale-readme
evals.prompt: our README is out of date, the new hire got stuck following it yesterday. can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: README.md updated in place: npm start replaced with npm run dev, Node 18 with Node 22, docker compose and npm run db:migrate added, SENDGRID_WEBHOOK_SECRET documented; the On-call section and existing headings kept as written. Not committed.
assertions: Every npm command in the README exists in package.json
Migration step added before the app runs
